company_info.company_name: JJA Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd
company_info.company_description: "John, the business owner, will personally see you through the whole process - from consultation through to installation and beyond. John offers a free consultation and quote, with honest expert advice. JJA Solar won’t do the hard sell. We are more interested in meeting your individual needs. If solar isn’t suitable for your property, you can guarantee we’ll let you know! "

reviews.review_description: John was prompt and professional in there approach to the job at hand. John only lives 10 minutes away and said if I have any problems just give him a ring.
Good fast clear service from John, would recommend to anyone else looking to get solar done

John was the only company of the 3 I was connected with that bothered to come out, inspect our roof and have the time to chat with me about the options as well as my concerns about a slightly more intricate install (we have a concrete roof).John was easy to get along with, got on with the job and did a FANTASTIC install - especially considering I'm very particular about the details and workmanship.Would absolutely highly recommend John and more than happy to support a local small business that actually cares about you, the system being installed and its fit.Upon reflection, I’m very happy that we picked a local small company over the bigger multi tiered solar companies where you end up dealing with a sales consultant who in my experience all had zero actual solar install experience.

Quote was greatJohn was punctual and tidy .From the quote to installation was about a week.Communication was fantastic.We are so confident with JJA Solar we are organising a quote for solar on the roof of our business at Bulli

John from JJA Solar was recommended to us, so we requested a quote after previously obtaining many quotes from other reputable installers.John was very quick to provide a comprehensive quote, checked in with me over the phone to ensure it was clear and received correctly, and also provided a competitive price for the exact system we wanted. His advice was helpful and he was not pushy at all.SAA Accreditation, industry experience and a quality system design and installation were important to us, and JJA Solar delivered on all fronts.The installation then went well, despite some factors out of his control affecting how long the installation would take. John worked tirelessly on the roof and completed everything neatly. PV System was up-and-running in no time.

My solar installation experience with John was very easy. From the quoting through to installation he was always contactable to answer my questions.He even returned in his own time to rectify a mistake my energy provider made during installation of a smart meter.Honest, easy to deal with and a very competitive quote.
Friendly, professional installer. Organised my provider for me. Was open to any questions I had.

John was amazing from beginning to end, out of the 3 quotes I had received John was the only one that personally called up and talked me through what I needed.  I had follow up questions over the span of 2 weeks and John responded to every one of those without any issues.I had received a bunch of other quotes that were close to half the price, however just having finished a new build I know too well what it meant if I went with one of the cheap options.  This is probably the deciding factor as I needed to make sure someone with experience was working on my roof, not negligently drilling holes and doing a quick/cheap job which usually leads to leaks and a much bigger headache later on.Once I accepted the quote John came himself personally and did my install over 2 days.  Was a nice change of pace to see the owner himself come out on site instead of a the usual subbie that has no idea.Was John worth every dollar? Absolutely.  Could I have saved heaps elsewhere, sure.  But I have the confidence in the job John has delivered and on that alone was worth the money.Also being local gave me that much more confidence so that was a big plus!

Quoting process was straight forward.  System was up and running in 3 days despite unfavourable weather in between.Jobs were done in polite and tidy manner.  Grid connection was confirmed by the energy retailer in 7 days.

John from JJA took the call stright away. He was on time for the quote. I got 3 more quotes and had a good look at all of them. John explained all my questions. The price was very good. The installation was neat, tidy and completed in no time.I would recomend JJA to anyone. Job well done.
John from JJA Solar was great to work with. Easy quote and very professional service. Installation was no fuss and they left site very neat and tidy. Would highly recommend John and JJA Solar.

Highly recommend.Fantastic service from quote to finished install.John is honest and reliable and was a pleasure to deal with.Very happy with the system supplied and the quality of work from John and his team.
Nothing was an issue. Everything well organised. Great customer service
Sales and quoting process went well.Installation was quick and smooth.Customer service was excellent and are helping with the grid connection

I have just signed an agreement for the installation of my solar system, so haven't reaped the benefits yet. The quoting process has been very simple and it was easy to compare products being offered by different suppliers. I was able to pick a great system for a reasonable price.
John Arfanis was very quick in providing me with a quote. The installation was on the day John advised and at the time he  promised.He answered all my questions and organised the grid connection.
Provided quote quick and it had everything that I had to ask for with other quotes. A mix up with install date, but quickly rectified. Friendly and easy to communicate with. Recommend.

I obtained 4 quotes. After discussions with each supplier decided to compare the two most suitable and got them to provide quotes on the same system components that I was interested in, I then selected JJ Solar based on price. JJ solar was great to deal with, the team was polite, efficient and tidy. John was easy to deal with, he arranged the grid connection and came back to check on his work and confirm I was pleased with the end result. The system looks great and is working well and as expected.
John Arfanis provided all of the above polite, tidy and punctual.John also showed how to install app onto mobile phone so you can track your solar usage at home and what is sold to the grid.
Installation done today everything went well punctual and tidy. Very happy with quote and service provided so far.

Quote process was prompt & any questions quickly answered. Installation was completed when scheduled, pleasant installers who also removed the old 1.5 KW system & left site tidy. The new 6.6 KW system was functioning immediately it was hooked up including excess power exported to the grid as no changes required from Energy Australia due to existing system installed was upgraded.
Helpful and honest about the product quick installWould recommend and doesn’t push it up sell

John has been a delight to deal with. I requested several different quotes and he delivered them in a timely manner. He always took my call and answered my questions. The install was quick and hassle free. John and his team cleaned up after themselves. John also assisted with setting up the app on my phone and with my service provider. i would happily refer JJA Solar.

John was very prompt with taking calls and response keeping me updated all the way to the actual installation. Any questions I had were answered straight away and the job was completed on time and looks fantastic.The app is very easy to use and track energy production and I would recommend using JJA Solar for your Installation.

John was easy to deal with and very accommodating with what we wanted for my sister's home. We were pleased to go local and the price was very competitive. The installation went well and the communication was terrific with photos etc as I was off-site. John has organised the grid connection and we are just waiting on the electricity supplier to finish. Thanks to John and the team.

John was friendly and promptly responded to any questions I had on the quote. The team arrived early and the install looks very neat and tidy and was up and running that afternoon. John looked after all the paper work and setup for the system monitoring as well as the grid connection. Any questions I had post install were quickly followed up and sorted.

I chose to go with John from JJA Solar because several people in our street had already used him and were very happy with the installation. John quoted promptly and there was a slight delay on choosing the install date due to bad weather to install, which was beyond everyone’s control. On the day, John arrived arrived early, battled through more bad weather and had the job done on same day. Everything went fine and smoothly. I decided to put the Sungrow inverter inside my garage and I don’t even notice it making any noise, it’s very quiet.I also decided to have the upgraded Sungrow consumption meter installed which gives me good info on how much electricity is being generated and used through the iSolarCloud app. There was a slight hiccup on the app as their software was being updated but that was resolved quickly and easily by John.John has submitted the paperwork to our energy provider so I’ll contact them next week to discuss their rates for solar.I’d happily recommend JJA Solar for a no fuss, no hassle competitive Solar install.

John provided a very competitive quote for a mid-tier system and was happy to provide another quote so I could compare with a premier system quoted by another installer. John answered all of my questions quickly and recommended I go with the cheaper system to achieve a quicker return on investment.The installation went without a hitch and was completed in about 5.5 hours. The work site was cleaned up and left spotless.John set up the grid connection and the app for the inverter on the day of installation. I struggled to navigate the Sungrow app and John was happy to make another visit to my house to assist me.

I had a 10kw system installed (Sunpower & Enphase) with JJA Solar & Electrical. John & his team showed up on time and finished the work on time. No hassle. The entire installation process was smooth. I can check how much energy the system generates and monitor consumption through Enphase and it's working as promised. I checked up and got quotes from many other installers, but JJA Solar will give you the best offer with a good quality of work. Thanks John. Good work!!  :)
Easy to quoteInstallation very tidySolaredge and QCells Panels look really good

Great guy, smooth and honest transaction with friendly support.Everything you need when lost in the world of online research and confusion of what you need or don't need.They helped me from the start of understanding what I am getting, what the options were and supporting me after installation. What more could you want?

John was great. He answered all my concerns and provided 3 different quotes with varying system size and quality of panels. It was helpful to get answers directly from the person who installs it. After accepting the quote, he gave me a ball park installation date which was within in 4 weeks. He arrived on time and installation was quick (5 hours) and simple. The house was left clean and tidy. Communication after installation was good regarding setting up monitoring, etc. It was a much simpler process than I expected.

Was recommended JJA Solar for our recent solar installation.From our initial meeting I found John to be honest and upfront, and more than happy to answer all of my many questions.He did not try to sell me a system that wastoo large for our needs , which instilled  trust in John and his company from the outset.His quotation  process was informative and prompt.Installation went like clockwork and the installation team were polite and kept us well informed.John was only too happy to help with setting up the system monitoring app and has set up grid connection with our energy retailer which will take place shortly.Overall a very positive experience and I would not hesitate to recommend John and his team.

Very happy with JJA Solar & Electrical. I had the pleasure of dealing with John the owner, qualified electrician & CEC accredited installer who has been in the business for over 10 years. The quote was competitive & installation was a smooth process, with no sub-contractors doing the job, as that was my biggest concern. John was very professional, happy to answer, very thoroughly all of my questions & concerns via email & in person. It’s refreshing to know that there are still genuine, honest people in the industry that care about looking after the customer & their reputation. I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending JJA Solar & Electrical.

John took the time to understand our situation and come up with a proposal that we then worked together to further refine to arrive at the final build.It was a no fuss install, good quality and quickly done by John himself not an outsourced installer like many solar companies.John answered all my questions (including the dumb ones).

Very happy with our solar installation.  We received quotes from several local businesses. John visited our house. He was easy to talk with and answered all our questions at the time, and later quickly responded to other queries we had.  Installation occurred in 1 day. JJA arrived on time and left the site tidy. John explained the equipment at the end of the day. The installation is neat and looks good.  Panels were installed on the north, east and west facing roofs and fitted in well with existing whirly birds and solar hot water system.  John arranged the paperwork etc for new smart meter/grid connection. The system has now been working 6 months and even though Sydney experienced a lot of wet weather we are finding our system is working well.  The solaredge app is great and well worth having, it provides immediate feedback on generation/consumption plus quickly helped us identify a fault with our hot water element.  More than happy to recommend JJA.

John from JJA came to my house to quote on a solar system. John took the time to understand my needs and some shade issues from a tree and designed a system that would work for us. John was open and honest with his advice when others were not interested in assisting with a quote.The tree was removed (for safety reasons) and John then adjusted the proposal. There was never any pressure from John and the installation was completer in a professional manner.John has also assisted with the grid connection that is due in the next few days.Happy to recommend JJA Solar to friends.
John and crew installed a 6.6Kwh system were very efficient, no fuss

John from JJA Solar was such a pleasure to deal with from initial contact, visiting my home and providing fantastic communication all the way through to installation. After doing extensive research and obtaining several other quotes from other companies within the Shire, JJA solar was by far the most competitive in pricing. Unlike other solar companies, when liaising with JJA, you are liaising with the actual owner and installer, not any third party sub contractor working for a company and doing the install. I was able to request to have all electrical pre-wiring to be done when my old roof was removed and before the new one was installed for a much neater look.  The install was very tidy and John was punctual and very polite providing progress at different stages during the installation process.I would highly recommend JJA knowing you have peace of mind that a top rated installer / owner with over 10 years experience is doing the actual solar installation.
The sales/quoting process was clear and precise.The installation went very well, they were punctual, polite and very tidyThey have organized the grid connection after the install.
Great service from start to end. Very punctual and quick installation. Very helpful with after service questions and organised the grid connection after installation. Highly recommend.
John made the process of getting solar simple. Great pricing, advice and install. No hard sell. Very happy with whole process.

John is a quietly spoken straight shooter. He gave a competitive quote and was happy to answer my questions when he came on site for a chat during the quote process.Installation was quick and efficient, JJA took away all the packaging material and the solar has been working great.

We sought 3 quotes before we engaged JJA Solar and found that they gave the best value pricing and service for the panels and inverter we needed. John's quoting system was very professional and the quote arrived with all the necessary information (which meant I really didn't have a lot of extra questions). it was all very self-explanatory.  We could sign and return the quote and were pretty quickly ready to go.Due to the wet weather we've experienced in Sydney in the last few months there was a bit of a delay in installing the panels.  However John was very professional in letting me know approximate time frames.  The installation was quick, tidy and completed with minimal fuss and interruption. JJA Solar really knew what they were doing and could answer any questions we had.We've been generating power for 2.5 days now and are obsessed with the SolarEdge app. its fantastic and so good to see how much energy we're generating, what we're pulling from the grid and when etc. Very happy to recommend  these guys.

The sales process was quite satisfactory.Polite, prompt, tidy and respectful installation.Service was very good, any explanations sought were always fortcoming, and Enphase Monitoring confirms the system is already working satisfactorily.Overall, a good experience.

The company gave a realistic estimate of when the work could be performed given the continuous wet weather we were having. Installation was carried out with minimum interruption to supply and grid connection and assistance with setting up monitoring applications given.

I spoke with a number of Solar companies before deciding to proceed with JJA Solar and John stood out due to his experience (in operation since 2010) and being a small business which meant he was here to complete the install himself (not using subcontractors).John arrived on time and the installation was completed professionally. It looks very neat and tidy and I am already noticing the benefits of having solar installed using the Fronius consumption monitoring app on my phone.John was patient and explained the whole process and most importantly he provided a competitive price for quality parts.I would have no hesitation in recommending JJA solar to my family and friends.

Easy, fast and responsive quotation process. Well priced for supply ind install of a solar system. Flexible options to suite my budget and energy consumption needs. Would highly recommend JJA Solar. I like being able to call the guy who runs the company and is the installer unlike some other companies who felt like call centres.Has organised grid connection and been very easy to deal with.

John was very helpful in discussing the best system for our house and, unlike some of the other companies that quoted, was not at all pushy. I chose John because of the good reviews I had read about the quality of the installation and he certainly delivered in this regard. On the day of installation, John himself with one other colleague arrived on time and quickly got to work locating the best wiring route and location for the Enphase Envoy system. His colleague set to work installing the racking for the panels on the roof. The whole installation was completed in under 5 hours including John setting up the Enlighten Monitoring system for the micro inverters and giving me a lesson in how it all works. The panels on the roof and the electrical installation are both very neat and they left the site very tidy. John also followed up in the days after the installation to make sure I was able to access the monitoring. Very happy with the experience and have no reservation in recommending JJA Solar and Electrical.

After searching for a trusty local installer for a while we found John from JJA Solar. John himself came out for a site inspection and we made a plan for a challenging site with periods of shade throughout the day. He was clear about what the system could and couldn’t do and provided a competitive quote. At no point was there any sales pressure, just good advice!The install was well organized, they got the panels installed and connected in about 6hrs and we were ready to go. The system has been performing well and any questions were quickly answered by John.
This company provided us with good service and a good price.

Quote and all subsequent follow received promptly.  John and his team were able to arrange our install during Sydney's COVID lock-down on relatively short notice.  Installation went without a hitch on our north and east facing roofs, adding to an earlier install (10+ years ago).  All work finished in about 6 hours.

I would not hesitate recommending John from JJA Solar.  As an electrician myself, I was fairly particular to know the detail of what was being proposed, how it would be installed and whether it would suit my situation (large home / household with three phase power and a massive power bill!).I sought three quotes via solar quotes and the proposed systems and price varied significantly, for a system of just over 20kW.  The quotes were from JJA Solar and two of the ‘big players’. John’s quote was not the cheapest by any means but was by far the most technically suitable for my home and included all the features I had requested (ie you get what you pay for!)John was a pleasure to deal with, always responsive to calls and texts (no call centre!) and reliably completed everything how and when it had been promised, to a professional standard. He had 61 panels to install on a 60 year old terracotta roof and only needed to replace 3 tiles during installation, which is a credit to his care and professionalism. John was personally on site with his employees during the installation.There were some minor commissioning Wifi glitches with the cloud-based monitoring, but John was responsive in ironing out the issues - he ran an additional Ethernet cable without any additional charge so that the system now operates 100% as intended.If you are after someone who is genuine, competent and offers old-fashioned personalised service, then don’t hesitate to engage John with total confidence.

Better value than other quotes, well explained and happy to answer questions. Installation was completed ahead of schedule due to another client being delayed. Customer service and install were great and he organised grid connection post.

Great quoting, as I requested quotes on 5 different inverters and panels, without hesitation he sent through. Yes polite and tidy on time finished in half a day. Even organised meter box to be updated by T2 Electrician for us and organised our energy company to put in smart meter for feed in tariffs. Hopefully meter box being updated tomorrow.

Right from our initial contact John was extremely courteous, helpful and professional. Absolutely no hard selling just good, sound advice and a fair price for what we required to meet our needs.When it came to installation they arrived on time and completed their work efficiently with minimal disruption to our routine. They also did a great job of cleaning up afterwards.John will be returning later this week after the Smart Meter has been installed to check that everything is working as it should be.

I found John to be easy to talk to and helpful and informative in his advice. From my perspective the quote was fair and reasonable. John and his off sider arrived on time and the installation went smoothly. Even cleaned our skylight for us. Thanks John.

I had a few quotes but couldn't go past John from JJA Solar and Electrical. John owns the company and is very knowledgeable when it comes to solar. We decided together on the brands of inverter and panels. Johns quote beat all the other quotes by far, up to $2000 cheaper than one of the competitors! John turned up when he said he would for installation, he left the site clean and even removed and took away my old broken system.I would highly recommend JJA Solar and Electrical.
Quoting was personal / professional.I have organised my own smart meter installation.

John from JJA Solar was the best price and provide exactly what I had asked for, mid range system at lowest cost.Further John came to my home and gave good advice for panel selection given my minor shading issue.On time, good price, good job, nice guy.

John was helpful explaining the  technical options. They turned up on time for the installation and cleaned up afterwards. I am awaiting the installation of the smart meter before I can judge the functionality of the system They completed the required forms to enable grid installation

John was great assistance as I was undertaking my research on different panels and inverters and it was a no-brainer when his quote was ultra competitive too. Very approachable and I highly recommend him to other people considering solar.

Of the 3 quotes, JJA Solar was the first to respond and provide a well laid out written quote.  This was one of only two companies that actually came out for an onsite inspection.  We were already impressed by their excellent rating & customer feedback.  We found John easy to deal with, and any changes discussed were included in the updated quote.  On acceptance we were provided with an installation date.  Like clockwork we received an SMS confirmation, and the team arrived onsite as advised.  JJA Solar complied with all our installation requests and completed the work the same day.  The site was left spotless.........couldn't ask for more.  John handled the paperwork to undertake the necessary meter changes.  Integrated monitoring solution works well and shows both consumption and generation, and is useful in adapting usage behavior. From start to finish a breeze.
Very professional, timely quote, came to visit site and gave good advice.  Installation on time and efficient.  Provided paperwork to us and our electricity supplier.

The experience with JJA Solar was very good from start to finish. John responded promptly to phone calls and emails. JJA was the only provider (I got 6 quotes in total) who suggested to max out the roof space, which I hadn’t considered doing. So instead of the ‘standard’ 6.6 kw system that most were pushing, we now have a 9.9kw system. This will allow for the addition of a heat pump for the pool. Co-incidentally our son and his family have moved back in with us, so there will be more power consumed than first anticipated!John was friendly and easy to deal with, the system was installed in less than a day.The install also included the Solar Analytics app which provides a great deal of information which I’m still learning about. Another suggestion from John, thanks.
Also recommended by a friend. Quick installation and quality of work very good.

John followed contacted us and visited our house to see clearly the installation. We had an older system that needed to be removed at the same time. John seta date and stuck to it, arriving on time and completing the removal and installation without fuss. Looking forward to seeing the savings. And while they were on the roof they cleaned all the leaves off for me.
Job well done. John answered all my questions, the quote was done at a fair price. John and his mate arrived for installation exactly on time, they were polite, quick and tidy. Great service.
Friendly, on time, easy to deal with, clean install and even went the extra mile to organise smart meter and grid connection.

From first point of contact John at JJA Solar was great to deal with.  Nothing was a hassle, I changed my mind twice and it was no bother to get a new quote. The price was very reasonable and there was no hard sell.Installation day they arrived on time, were very pleasant and very efficient. I the install was much quicker than I expected and there was no mess after.John also arranged the Smart meter to be installed and explained the process really well.Thank you John and Will, I have recommended you to others, one who has used you already and I will continue to do so.

Overall a good experience. John is very approachable and happy to answer questions and give advice. He does not give the hard sell or push any particular products.I requested multiple variations of the quote for comparison purposes, the price was consistently competitive.We installed the Fronius Symo 10kw inverter with 13.3kw Trina 330W Honey panels.The installation was smooth and completed in one day by John himself and one other installer.Broken roof tiles were replaced and supplied by JJA Solar.The system was connected to the Fronius monitoring app. So far we have been clocking 65-74kwH daily and it has been somewhat overcast.We are very happy with JJA Solar and are glad we were able to support an owner operator local business.

Installer came to our house, didn't just rely on an aerial photo. Installer was happy to update the quote with the specific system components and brands that we wanted. Was also happy to answer any questions we had. Turned up for installation as scheduled. Installer was responsive to our questions and quickly resolved issues we had with accessing the monitoring system following the installation.

I'm not an electrical specialist / engineers so I can't comment on the technical component of the install. Against that backdrop, everything went very very well. I'd expressed concern re the positioning of the inverter re wifi coverage from my router. To counter that concern, JJA Solar were more than happy to come back and hard-wire the data connection if needed, I was impressed by that and I do trust JJA Solar to return if there are wifi issues.The only observation - it would have been better to have submitted the new meter paperwork weeks before the solar install rather than after the install. If submitted earlier, the feed in tariff benefits would have been realizsng day i & JJA Solar would not need to come back and finish the install. JJA advised that it would take up to 21 working days to replace meter. So, currently we are not realising the full benefits from our solar install. It's not a major issue, more of a streamlining of the whole process.

reviews.review_description: We chose John for a number of reasons, the main one being that he owned the company and was the installer, so we felt the installation warranty would mean something. Even though he could have quoted off site, he came to our home so that we could meet him. He was on time, neatly dressed and answered our questions clearly, both on the day and many emails afterwards. He kept us up to date on the progress of the order and the installation went smoothly. He suggested a much better position for the inverter and connected it all to wifi so we were ready to go. He was recommended to us and we wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to others.

Quick quoting process and installed on appointed day. So far so good.I looked after grid connection myself but you should ring your retailer to have meters changed to solar about two weeks before installation of the panels because it takes that long to happen. Otherwise you are sitting there with solar panels on your roof and not benefitting from it. Talk to your electricity retailer early in the process and try to co ordinate the installation of the panels with the conversion of your electricity meter.

JJA Solar were very easy to deal with and a good price, they turned up on the day and time that was arranged and the installation went without a hitch and the grid connection was arranged by them with ausgrid very happy with their service.

John did a great job installing our 8kw system. He is very polite and easy to deal with. They got the job done in a single day even with strong winds in the afternoon that made the install more difficult to achieve.

The quote was given quickly and easily without any fuss.Installation went ahead on an agreed date and was done well with all questions answered. John was great.After the installation John went ahead and organised connection with my retailer, all-round great service.

We used JJA solar becausethe the high reviews.We found the whole process to be seemless.John was great to deal with.The installation quality was excellent. John wanted to ensure there was limited visual impact with the external cabling/conduit.I would recomend anyone to use JJA Solar for a professional job
I found John had a competitive price, he was responsive and happy to work in with my builder to get a seamless outcome for me. Happy customer

I obtained a few quotes for my solar installation and John was the only one who took the trouble to come out and explain the process and physically inspect my property. The others did it all remotely via quoting software which generated a report (John supplied this also) but the fact he cared enough to come out was a point of difference for me.He has also been doing solar installations for over a decade and is a very experienced electrician. There are a lot of new operators to this game trying to capitalize on the rising industry so it was important for me to avoid those. He also is the owner of the business and does not send subcontractors out to do the work on his behalf which was something Iâ€™d been warned to avoid. Iâ€™m told this has caused problems in the past if/when warranty claims are made. His offsider, Willy, was also a lovely guy and they appeared to work very well together.Johns communication was also excellent. I sent many emails with questions as well as phone calls and texts, as I like to cover off every detail, and he answered them very promptly and without any annoyance which was refreshing. Often you can get push back from trades for asking too many questions but spending this much money is a big decision and John completely understood that.He also went the extra mile by moving my TV antennae to ensure no shading on the panels and willing to promptly rectify any concerns or problems that arose.The quote was very competitive and he didnâ€™t try to sell me on expensive solar monitoring software that others did, even though he provided it as an option. The quote was well balanced with a few options.Overall excellent customer service and price and a very positive experience. I have no hesitation recommending JJA solar for your installation.

John and his team at JJA solar were punctual and straight to the point.JJA solar has great communication and are very punctual. They have kept me informed during the process leading up to the install and throughout the install itself.The install was completed smoothly and the site left clean afterwards. We are just waiting on the meter upgrade of which the paper work has been lodged.There was no sales pitch trying to push one way or the other, just honest and quality outcomes. Would happily recommend JJA solar.

John form JJA Solar did a great job in installing my 6.6kw system.  The rain meant that he had to visit my house on 3 occassions so that the job could be completed.  John organised the approval and hook up with my electrical supplier.  I was extreemly happy with his service.

John at JJA was very accommodating. He modified his quote as requested and when he found out that 3 phase wiring to the house was not required he reduced his quote appropriately. The work was completed very quickly. The tenants seem satisfied although I have no feedback on the performance of the system. The new system replaced an existing system that was damaged in a storm.
John was helpful, efficient and friendly. I would recommend JJA solar to anyone looking for a reliable installer.

John was very prompt in returning our call and an appointment was arranged to come and give us a quote. John turned up on time and was very informative and helpful.  On  installation day John was again prompt,  work was completed and everything was cleaned up on completion.  John helped with the arranging of the grid install.  We found John to punctual and polite and it was a pleasure to do business with him and highly recommend him.

After being assured by much larger solar companies that their quoted prices were â€œunmatchableâ€, I approached John from JJA Solar for a quote. To my surprise, he did not only match the price I had previously been quoted, but significantly bettered it with the brands of the panels and inverter being exactly the same.Through the whole process from quotation to installation, I could not fault John or his staff on any aspect. Professional and prompt service, together with a value for money system, is what you can expect from John. It was also great to be able to support a local business.

contact with recommended installer was quick and timely. Agreed date was kept and all installed in that one day. Workmen quiet and continuous all day.Currently at the stage of still waiting for energy company to do their part to get underway. Project not completed yet

Very easy quoting service. The first quote was actioned the next day and the next withing 3 days.
